scene_description: A woman wearing an apron is standing at a kitchen stove, stirring something in a pan. Steam is rising from the pan. A basket of vegetables and fruits sits on the counter nearby. A ladle hangs on the wall in the background.

questions.question: What is the woman holding in her hand?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the woman has in her hand near the stove.

questions.question: What is the woman doing at the stove?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the woman's hands and the pan on the stove.

questions.question: Where is the woman cooking?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the room around the woman — the stove and counter.

questions.question: What is the basket of vegetables for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the basket on the counter and think about what we do with vegetables.

questions.question: What might come out of the pan that we can see rising up?
questions.sentence_frame: I can see ___ coming out of the pan.
questions.evidence_hint: Look above the pan — something is rising up from the hot food.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever helped cook food in the kitchen?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were in the kitchen with a grown-up.
